overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly targeted professional presence across decentralized and professional social media platforms. His content, focusing on computational social science, disinformation, and academic opportunities, resonates deeply with his niche audience, resulting in high organic engagement rates across all platforms.

contentThemes.description: Research updates, paper publications, and tool releases (like CooRnet v2.0) focusing on identifying coordinated sharing behavior and disinformation.
Announcements regarding research grants, hiring postdoctoral researchers, and promoting PhD opportunities in computational social science.

recommendations: Capitalize on Bluesky's highly active academic community by sharing early-stage research questions and fostering collaborative discussions.
Utilize LinkedIn primarily for high-impact professional milestones, recruitment drives, and funding announcements to leverage its larger follower base.
Improve Mastodon engagement by directly embedding links to tools, publications, or code repositories to encourage hands-on interaction.

platformInsights.bluesky: Yields the highest relative engagement rate (averaging ~6.1%), indicating a highly receptive and dense academic community interested in computational social science.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves a smaller, niche audience where technical tool releases (e.g., CooRnet v2.0) perform significantly better than general discussion topics.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest absolute volume of engagements, making it the ideal channel for professional networking, institutional visibility, and recruitment.

topPerformingContent.content: Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
New research opportunity for PhD students interested in computational social science. Reply for details!
Excited to announce that our research team has been awarded a new grant to study information operations across social media platforms.
